_about: recoil1: poses for Encounter's step 3 cue events, generated by render/anim/tools/wave_gen.mjs from render/anim/tools/waves/recoil1.mjs. Played by AnimFighter (step 3 cues and ground contact). Render only, outside the sim's data hash.

rc.skip.hop._orig: the first step back: the weight thrown onto the rear foot, the feet barely off the ground, the arms out for balance

rc.skip.step._orig: the second step: landing low on the rear foot, the guard coming up

rc.handspring.plant._orig: a back handspring begun: sitting back into the knees, both arms swung up and back past the head to take the ground behind him

rc.handspring.over._orig: over the hands: the body one long line, the arms straight above the head (the turn puts them on the ground), the legs together and following

rc.handspring.land._orig: the landing: both feet down in a low crouch, the guard coming back up

rc.handspring_one.plant._orig: a one-handed back handspring begun: the near hand swung back for the ground, the other kept up in guard

rc.handspring_one.over._orig: over the one hand, the guard hand held

rc.back_tuck.kick._orig: thrown back off the blow: the spine arching, the arms swept up and back

rc.back_tuck.tuck._orig: one tight turn: the knees drawn to the chest, the hands near the shins and apart, the head tucked

rc.back_tuck.open._orig: opening out of the turn: the feet reaching down, the arms wide for balance

rc.backflip_layout.load._orig: the spring: sunk low, the arms swung back and down

rc.backflip_layout.kick._orig: the layout: the whole body arched and open, the arms flung up and wide, the legs together below

rc.backflip_layout.long._orig: the long open arc: the body straight, the arms spread wide, the legs reaching

rc.backflip_layout.open._orig: coming round: the feet reaching for the ground, the arms wide

rc.backflip_layout.land._orig: landing in stance, the knees taking it, the guard coming up

rc.backflip_tuck.load._orig: the spring, compact: sunk low, the arms drawn back close

rc.backflip_tuck.kick._orig: off the ground in one line, the arms short

rc.backflip_tuck.tuck._orig: the tuck: knees to the chest, no wasted rotation, the hands near the shins and apart

rc.backflip_tuck.open._orig: out of the tuck: the feet down, the arms only as wide as balance needs

rc.backflip_tuck.land._orig: landing in an exact low crouch, square

rc.wall.fly._orig: flying at the wall feet first, the arms out for balance

rc.wall.plant._orig: the plant: both feet flat on the wall, the knees folding to take it, the arms in

rc.wall.push._orig: the push: the legs driving straight, the body springing away off the wall, the arms swinging up

rc.ground.reach._orig: a rebound off the ground: the hands set down in front, the weight over them

rc.ground.spring._orig: the spring back up: the arms swinging up, the legs trailing, the head up
